title: Re-check a visual review run's gate
description: Re-check the gate of a completed, unfinalized run after a quarantine or toleration: recount unresolved snapshots, post the commit status, and re-run the CI job recorded on the run, so the required check reads the new verdict. Call it on the pull request's latest non-stale run. Approved changes keep the gate red until finalize commits them. `ci_rerun_triggered` and `ci_rerun_error` report the re-run.

methodDocumentation.text: Re-evaluate quarantine and counts, update commit status, and optionally rerun the CI job.

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription:
Why CI submitted the run. `review` runs gate the PR and need approval. `observe` runs are tracking-only, for example default-branch pushes and merge-queue runs, and can never be approved.

* `review` - review
* `observe` - observe

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription:
How this row matched the `search` query parameter: `exact` (the term is a case-insensitive substring of branch/run type, a commit SHA prefix, or an exact PR number) or `similar` (a fuzzy trigram match, returned only when no exact match exists). Null when the list is not filtered by `search`.

* `exact` - exact
* `similar` - similar
